purpose: silver_nyc_planes provides cleaned aircraft registration reference data (tail number, manufacturer, model, engine configuration, and capacity) intended to be joined against flight fact tables for downstream analytics on aircraft characteristics.
usage: Join downstream flight tables to this table on tailnum to enrich records with aircraft attributes; consumers should expect and explicitly handle nulls in year (about 2.1% of rows) and should treat speed as largely unavailable since 99.3% of rows have a null speed value.
limitations: Cleanup could not resolve the null rates present in bronze: year is null for 2.1% of rows and speed is null for 99.3% of rows, both retained as nullable rather than imputed; the three Airbyte capture metadata columns were dropped and are not available in this table.
